title: "BOKeTE" Official Music Video Released — Cinematic Heartbreak Film Shot in Puerto Rico
detail: Bad Bunny released the official music video for "BOKeTE" on April 25, 2026 — the latest visual from his Grammy Album of the Year *Debí Tirar Más Fotos* (January 2025). Directed with a cinematic sensibility, the video captures the bachata-influenced heartbreak track through nostalgic imagery set across Puerto Rico: Bad Bunny leans against a payphone in an abandoned city, wanders alone by rivers and beaches, and sits at a formal dinner table delivering a monologue — "Thank God I'm alive, and that's what matters. I've fallen in love 515 times, and with you, it's 516." The title "BOKeTE" compares an ex-girlfriend to a pothole — a recurring metaphor that doubles as commentary on Puerto Rico's infrastructure. Coverage from Billboard, Rolling Stone, and Remezcla highlighted the video's emotional resonance and cinematic production quality, consistent with the album's broader visual storytelling ambition.
